pick_implementation.title: Connect your Pantrist account
pick_implementation.description: Authorize Home Assistant to access your Pantrist data.

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect your Pantrist account
reauth_confirm.description: Your Pantrist refresh token is no longer valid. Re-authorize to continue receiving updates.

abort.missing_configuration: Pantrist Application Credentials are not set up.
abort.missing_list_id: Pantrist did not return a list ID — please try again and pick a list during the consent step.
abort.already_configured: This Pantrist list is already connected.
abort.wrong_account: Re-authentication picked a different list than the original. Remove this entry and add a new one instead.
abort.invalid_auth: The Pantrist API rejected the access token. Please try again.
abort.cannot_connect: Could not reach the Pantrist API. Please check your connection and try again.

socket_disconnected.title: Pantrist real-time updates interrupted
socket_disconnected.description: The Pantrist Socket.IO connection for list {list_name} has been down for ~{minutes} min. List contents will update again automatically when the connection is restored — no action is needed unless this persists. If it does, check Settings → System → Logs for ``custom_components.pantrist`` errors.

not_configured.message: Pantrist integration is not configured. Add the integration before calling this service.

unknown_list_id.message: No Pantrist coordinator for list_id={list_id}. Available: {available}.

number_set_failed.message: Could not change pantry amount for {name}: {error}
